item.title: Stranded travelers scramble to make new connections as war shuts much of Middle East to air travel
item.description: FlightAware reported more than 2,800 flights were canceled Sunday across major Middle Eastern airports.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Traders were betting the supply of oil could slow or grind to a halt.

item.title: At least 22 people killed in Pakistan as protesters try to storm US Consulate
item.description: The violence came after the attack on Iran.

item.title: Mid Valley Line Dancers perform at health care center
item.description: The Mid Valley Line Dancers recently performed at Mid Valley Health Care Center. From left: Cathy Gillette, Rose Ann Romanczyk, Donna Keklak, Donna Stuchlak, Kathy Ewonishon, Marguerite Dippel, Linda Norton and dance instructor Tim Norton.

item.title: Mid Valley Line Dancers perform at nursing home
item.description: The Mid Valley Line Dancers recently performed for the residents at Serenity Care Nursing Home, Peckville. Standing, from left: Donna Stuchlak, Cathy Gillette, Donna Keklak, Rosie Romanczyk, Diane Piasecki, Marguerite Dippel, Michelle Kubrick, Linda Norton and JoAnn Appleyard. Kneeling: Tim Norton, line dancer and instructor.

item.title: County’s 2026 digital budget book available online
item.description: The digital budget book is an online tool designed to make the county's annual operating budget more accessible, transparent and digestible to residents and taxpayers.

item.title: POINT: Section 230 is no longer defending free speech
item.description: Thirty years ago, Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act was born out of real concerns for the future.

item.title: COUNTERPOINT: Update Section 230 for the age of algorithmic distribution
item.description: It’s the 30th anniversary of Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act, a law that says that communications platforms aren’t legally responsible for what users post.

item.title: False claims laws have brought in millions. Why hasn’t it passed in Pa.?
item.description: Advocates for the legislation say without it, the state is missing a key tool to fight fraud and is losing out on millions in federal dollars.

item.title: Editorial: Waging war with Iran is in no one’s best interest
item.description: The U.S. and Iran are hurtling toward a conflict neither ostensibly wants but both seem unable to avoid. The long-standing rivals ought to pause and think carefully about where their true interests lie.
